name: Lucrenn
description: Lucrenn was a world located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Skine sector. Around the year 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of Galindas Exports, a fencing operation and member of the criminal Tenloss Syndicate.
